jobs.title: Senior Consultant Specialist
jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Senior Consultant Specialist.
Business: Fin, Supervision and TR Tech
Job ID: 57388
Principal Responsibilities
Own CCR input data quality end-to-end: sourcing, preparation, mapping, enrichment, and validation for trades, collateral, agreements/netting sets, counterparty reference data, and market data.
Translate business outcomes into clear technical requirements (definitions, assumptions, acceptance criteria, control totals, and signoffs).
Design and run data controls: completeness, consistency, timeliness, reconciliation, and explainability of exposure movements.
Partner with stakeholders (Traded Risk, XVA/Finance, Front Office, Collateral, etc.) to resolve breaks, agree “source of truth”, and deliver at pace.
Drive modernization: support migration to microservices, Kafka/event-driven patterns, and improved observability (logs/metrics/traces), across GCP and on‑prem.
Support production stability: incident triage, root-cause analysis, runbooks, cut-off management (EOD/intraday), and controlled releases.
Work closely with developers and quants integrating Java/Python services with in-house C++ analytics libraries.
Identify and deliver AI use cases across CCR IT processes (e.g., data quality triage, automated breaks classification, exposure movement explanation drafts, control optimization), prioritizing those with clear risk reduction and efficiency gains.
Build and embed “AI-assisted operations” into BAU:
auto-summarization of incidents and change requests,
faster root-cause hypothesis generation using logs/metrics/traces,
automated runbook recommendations and knowledge-based upkeep.
Apply ML / statistical techniques for proactive controls such as anomaly detection on feed volumes, data drifts, reconciliation breaks, unexpected exposure movements, and limit breaches (with transparent thresholds and human override).
Enable safe, controlled GenAI usage for technical and non-technical outputs: requirements drafting, test-case generation, release notes, reconciliation commentary, stakeholder updates—ensuring correctness, auditability, and appropriate approvals.
Partner with engineering, data, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions are compliant and production-ready (model monitoring, change control, access controls, traceability, and clear ownership).
Measure value and outcomes: define KPIs (time-to-triage, break backlog, control failure rates, manual effort saved) and continuously improve solutions based on evidence.
Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications
Strong experience in risk/finance technology with a focus on data pipelines and controls (trade + reference + market data).
Good working knowledge of CCR fundamentals: exposure/PFE concepts, collateral & CSA terms, close-out netting, and how results aggregate (trade → netting set → counterparty/group).
Experience clarifying requirements with senior stakeholders and communicating clearly in writing (decisions, assumptions, impact).
Hands-on engineering ability in Java and/or Python, plus solid SQL and data analysis skills.
Production mindset: troubleshooting, incident management, and building observable and auditable systems.
Practical experience applying AI to workflows (not just theory): automation of repetitive analysis, operational processes, or decision-support in a controlled environment.
Strong Python for AI-enabled engineering: working with notebooks and/or services, prompt engineering basics, and integrating AI components via APIs into existing systems/processes.
Ability to validate AI outputs: establishing human-in-the-loop checks, quality gates, evaluation metrics, and clear audit trails so outputs are explainable and trustworthy.
Structured problem-solving mindset: can translate messy operational pain points into automatable steps (process mapping, control points, data requirements).
What additional skills will be good to have?
Experience with SA‑CCR implementation/support and/or CVA/XVA (including sensitivities).
Familiarity with Kafka, microservices patterns, schema versioning, and replay/idempotency.
Experience operating on GCP (and hybrid on‑prem/cloud setups).
Exposure to stress testing and regulatory reporting.
Experience with ML anomaly detection / time-series analysis for operational monitoring and data quality (e.g., drift, outlier detection, reconciliation break prediction).
Experience building internal tooling (e.g., workflow automation, ticket enrichment, knowledge search, runbook copilots) that improves team throughput.
Familiarity with model risk / AI governance concepts (e.g., monitoring, versioning, controlled rollout, documentation).

jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AVP - CRM.
Principal responsibilities
CLCM and product LCM oversight
Support CLCM across all propositions/ channels/ products in AMH WPB with a primary focus on customer activation and relationship deepening, driving customers from perfect onboarding to grow along vintage to become engaged customers and use HSBC as main bank.
CRM demand management
Support CRM demand management to ensure business demand prioritisation is based on strategic intent to maximize CLCM impact
Socialise the performance results and share best practices with product teams for continuous optimisation
Innovation projects

Customer outcomes
Create exceptional value for customers by elevating personalised messaging to support customer needs along the wealth building journey.
Requirements
Excellent understanding of wealth and personal banking products on top of digital commercialisation, with strong business focus in customer propositions and segmentation
Possesses relevant retail banking experience at project/product owner level preferred
Understanding of Hong Kong retail banking market and mainland China strategic market
Hands on experience in managing projects of high complexity, with strong planning, organization, problem-solving skills and attentiveness to details
Strong commercial acumen - ability to link data to business and customer outcomes
Great sense of ownership; excellent relationship building and senior stakeholder management skills including an ability to operate in a complex, matrix driven environment

jobs.title: Senior Trader, HSBC Qianhai (GCB 5)
jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC Qianhai
HSBC Qianhai Securities Limited (HSBC Qianhai), a joint venture securities company, was incorporated on 28 August 2017, pursuant to Supplementary Agreement X to the Closer Economic Partnership Arrangements (CEPA) between the mainland and Hong Kong.
The registered capital of HSBC Qianhai is RMB1.8 billion. The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited (HSBC) holds 90% of the shares, while Qianhai Financial Holdings Co., Ltd. (QFH) holds the remaining 10%. Our headquarters are located in Qianhai, Shenzhen. We have branch offices in Beijing and Shanghai, and a trading outlet in Qianhai, Shenzhen.
By combining solid expertise in the domestic capital market with the global competitive advantage of the HSBC Group, we are committed to providing our customers with comprehensive securities services and a diverse range of products, aspiring to be your unique partner in China's onshore capital markets.
Our purpose – ‘Opening up a world of opportunity’ – explains why we exist. For information about our purpose and values, please visit HSBC.com.
HSBC Qianhai is part of one of the world’s largest financial services organisations. Whether you are an experienced professional, looking for your first job, or are interested in one of our student and graduate programmes, we provide many ways for you to develop your skills and achieve your career ambitions in a diverse and inclusive environment.
We offer opportunities across our organisation to build a fulfilling career and work with colleagues and customers around the world. We have roles available in business areas including Investment Banking, Securities Brokerage, Investment Advisory, Securities Proprietary Trading, Asset Management and Private Wealth Management, and Functions, Digital Business Services.
We look for people who are ambitious and want to develop their career and contribute to HSBC’s long-term, sustainable growth. We want employees who can help us achieve our strategy, balance social, environmental and economic considerations and manage risk accordingly.
To ensure we achieve this growth in the right way, we place great emphasis on our values. We are committed to applying the highest standards throughout the company, everywhere we do business.
Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of our business. Joining HSBC will give you the opportunity to work in a collegiate and supportive environment in which we seek to develop and promote you based on merit.
We also have a strong commitment to sustainability and encourage employees to participate in our community projects and other activities.
Responsibilities Of The Role Holder
Execute PM’s placements in the trading books, including hedge trade execution, risk management, price taking and volatility management.
Support desk to manage the liquidity risk and good relationship with counterparties.
Sharing the market color, popular trading strategies and execute the strategies proved by Team head, preform back-test on hedging trading strategies.
Collaborate with analysis on product design and pricing strategy.
Demonstrate high professionalism.
Understand, follow and demonstrate full compliance with all relevant internal and external regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of HSBC, also in line with the Code of Conduct.
Conduct and support BAU where applicable.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
MSc+ Degree in engineering/science/Finance related subject from Chinese/Overseas university.
3 year+ experience on FI products trading and has solid performance record.
Strong proficiency in written and spoken Chinese and English.
5-year Working experience in onshore Chinese Fixed Income market.
Eligibility to work in mainland China.

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Proactively manage a complex portfolio of clients, becoming a trusted advisor to lead strategic dialogues with clients at a portfolio level through the understanding of specific business requirements and delivering creative and flexible customer solutions
To hand over customer relationship properly to their relationship managers after closing sales
To provide excellent services to customers and ensure all enquiries and complaints are accurately and effectively resolved to customers' satisfaction
To participate actively in team building activities to share information/ideas while contributing suggestions for work improvement

University degree or above (recognized by the state)
Strong interpersonal skills and effective presentation skills
Well-developed service and sales attitude with ability to work under pressure
Presentable, Outgoing and Persuasive

jobs.title: Admin Support Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking(CIB)

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Assist banker(s) in managing the existing portfolio, acquiring new business and maintenance of relevant client management systems.

  • Gather information required for the preparation of credit proposals including financial analysis for new facilities, facility review and facility amendments;
  • Gather information required for the preparation of customer call reports;
  • Maintain & validate relevant client management system;
  • Follow up with customers on daily / routine credit operational matters;
  • Attend to routine matters arising from the portfolio of accounts assigned;
  • Handle both external & internal facility related enquiries;
  • Identifying cross-sell opportunities and assisting the Relationship Manager(s) in developing business strategies and marketing activities to maximize the Bank's profit; and
  • Act as backup Relationship Officier to the team.

Ensures good lending disciplines and safeguards the bank from potential loss due to non-compliance with local regulations/procedures.

  • Prepare CARM applications on new, amended and revised facilities, maintain an accurate, updated data in CARM system for transmission to Credit Operations;
  • Maintain and validate security documentations;
  • Maintain credit files in a timely and orderly manner to ensure that there is no overdue review;
  • Handle miscellaneous internal customer / product / credit related enquiries by coordinating and processing relevant MI and compliance returns;
  • Assist Relationship Manager(s) in achieving satisfactory ratings from internal and external auditors.

Increase HSBC brand recognition and assist banker in making HSBC the leading foreign bank in the local place .

  • Maintain a professional image when interacting with customers;
  • Assist banker(s) in various PR activities;
  • Participate in the bank's marketing/ promotion and sponsorship programmes

Develop skills to meet existing and future business needs.

  • Keep abreast of developments in the market and regulatory environment that may have an impact on our customers, business and risk;
  • Manage self-development including timely completion of mandatory courses, attend to relevant internal briefing / training / update as well as relevant learning roadmap / internal business school.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

Requirements

The job-holder is required to deliver outstanding service, identify non-fund income and cross-sell opportunities as well as meeting the demanding requirements from customers, regulators and internal stakeholders. As such, he / she would need to process:

  • Customer oriented mind set
  • Analytical skill
  • Organization skills
  • General knowledge on banking products
  • Interpersonal & communication skills

jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of AVP, MGOC TNO ANALYTICS, GRA.
Principal responsibilities
The Purpose Of The Role Is To
Analyze and interpret regulatory requirements and internal policies related to model risk management, particularly in the context of Traded Risk models.
Collaborate with model developers and owners to ensure compliance with model governance policies throughout the model lifecycle.
Develop and document internal procedures and templates to support model developers in adhering to regulatory standards and best practices.
Maintain and update the model inventory, ensuring accuracy and completeness of model records, including all models and adjustments.
Track the status of models, including their validation, approval, and performance monitoring metrics.
Prepare formal documentation, including procedures, meeting packs, and regular model governance reports for senior management and governance committees.
Assist in coordinating and conducting periodic model reviews and validations in collaboration with validators.
Identify opportunities to automate governance processes, reducing manual effort and enhancing operational efficiency.
Develop tools and applications to enable more efficient and streamline model risk governance
Stay updated on industry trends, regulatory changes, and best practices in model risk management.
Provide guidance to model owners and stakeholders on governance policies and best practices.
Analyze different problem statements for actionable insights to support model-related activities.
Requirements
Strong proficiency in Python, including experience with libraries such as pandas, numpy, plotly, and dash
Hands-on experience building web applications using Dash (Plotly)
Good understanding of version control systems (e.g., Git)
Solid software development practices (modular code, testing, documentation)
Ability to analyze and visualize data effectively
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

jobs.descriptionText:

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Consultant Specialist
.
Business:
CTO Data Technology
Job ID:50261
Principal Responsibilities
Lead delivery of one or more workstreams/squads to deliver agreed outcomes (customer, operational, regulatory), using Agile delivery practices and appropriate governance.
Own and drive delivery plans (roadmaps, sprint/release plans, milestones), ensuring transparency of progress, risks, issues, and dependencies.
Facilitate Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives) and promote continuous improvement.
Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects and Engineering Leads to shape delivery scope into executable backlogs and prioritised increments.
Proactively manage RAID (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) and drive mitigation actions to closure.
Manage delivery governance and reporting (status updates, steering materials, metrics), ensuring stakeholders have clear, timely information.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Senior Business Analyst.
Business: CTO Data Technology
Principal Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end BA delivery across Data Control initiatives: DMOV, DSTO, DQ, and retention/lifecycle controls.
Elicit, analyse, and document requirements; translate into epics/features/user stories with clear acceptance criteria and traceability.
Define requirements for ingestion, storage patterns/tiering, and distribution, including interfaces, mappings, dependencies, and NFRs.
Drive data retention and disposal requirements (retention schedules, legal holds, exceptions), ensuring solutions are implementable and auditable.
Embed governance, risk, and control requirements (classification, access, auditability, metadata/lineage) into delivery outcomes.
Support SIT/UAT, defect triage, release readiness, and BAU handover.
Manage senior stakeholders, facilitate workshops, and coach junior BAs to raise analysis quality and consistency.
Requirements
Strong BA experience delivering complex technology change (Agile and/or hybrid).
Solid knowledge of data movement and storage concepts (batch/streaming, landing/curation layers, tiering).
Demonstrable experience defining data retention/lifecycle requirements and translating them into delivery-ready stories and controls.
Strong stakeholder management across Technology, Data Governance, and control/risk teams.
Excellent facilitation and documentation skills; able to turn ambiguity into structured, testable requirements.
Experience with cloud/hybrid data platforms, data catalogue, and lineage tooling.
Working knowledge of privacy/security controls (masking, tokenisation, encryption, audit logging).
Experience operating within a financial services control environment.
SQL and/or data profiling experience to validate requirements and DQ rules.
PMP / PRINCE2 (or equivalent) certification.
BCBS 239 practical experience in a bank (e.g., lineage, DQ controls, ownership/stewardship, governance/audit evidence).
Able to work with limited documentation; proactive, self-sufficient, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.
Strong English communication and collaboration skills across global teams/time zones.
Continuous improvement mindset and curiosity to understand how platforms/systems work end-to-end.
What additional skills will be good to have?
Prior experience working with Architecture Engineering / Solution Architecture teams.
6+ years in data-focused delivery/analysis.
3+ years working in Agile/DevOps environments.
Typical tools：Jira/Confluence, Visio/Lucidchart/Miro, SQL/query & profiling tools, catalogue/metadata tools.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Ops Support
jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Manager, Ops Support.
Principal responsibilities
Drive operational performance improvements that sustain in BAU
Identify operational pain points and performance levers using MI, quality outcomes, rework themes, and colleague feedback.
Deliver measurable improvements in service performance (e.g., turnaround time, SLA adherence, productivity, quality) and track outcomes through stabilization, not just implementation.
Reduce operational friction by removing non-value steps, clarifying decision points, and standardizing execution across teams where appropriate.
Translate operational needs into implementable change (AI-enabled and non-AI)
Define clear operational requirements for changes: end-to-end process flows, exception handling, control points, evidence requirements, and “what good looks like” in live operations.
Partner with Technology teams to enable automation/digitization (e.g., workflow automation and AI-enabled assistance where applicable), ensuring solutions reflect real operational scenarios, exceptions, and constraints.
Coordinate operational testing and validation (including edge cases) to confirm solutions are practical, controlled, and ready for frontline use.
Deliver simplification of process and policy (with control integrity)
Identify and priorities simplification opportunities that reduce complexity and rework while remaining aligned to risk appetite and customer outcomes.
Work with relevant policy/process owners and control stakeholders to implement simplifications with clear rationale, documented controls impact, and appropriate approvals.
Embed simplified policies/processes into BAU through updated procedures, clearer guidance, and reinforced execution routines.
Ensure operational readiness, adoption, and continuous improvement
Ensure readiness for rollout: procedures/SOP updates, training approach, comms, escalation paths, capacity considerations, and fallback arrangements.
Support teams through go-live and learning curves; address adoption blockers (knowledge gaps, unclear steps, tool usability issues, control confusion).
Establish and maintain post-change operating routines (MI cadence, quality calibration, issue triage, continuous improvement loops) so changes remain effective over time.
Strengthen MI and decision-making
Produce and leverage complex MI to manage performance, prioritize action, and evidence benefits (capacity, backlog drivers, SLA/TAT, quality/error trends).
Provide timely status and decision-oriented updates on risks, issues, dependencies, and outcomes; recommend corrective actions grounded in operational reality.
Risk, control effectiveness, quality and audit readiness
Proactively identify operational risks and control gaps using MI, error/rework themes, incidents, audit/assurance feedback and frontline observations—particularly where risks may be introduced by operating model changes, simplification, or AI-enabled workflow adoption.
Support remediation by defining practical corrective actions (process, controls, training and guidance), tracking actions to evidence-based closure, and ensuring fixes translate into sustained BAU practice.
Embed control requirements into changes from the outset (control points, approvals, auditability, evidence capture, exception handling and fallback arrangements) so new ways of working remain safe and compliant.
Maintain quality and audit readiness through disciplined BAU routines (quality measurement/calibration, investigation support, documentation and evidence standards) and timely closure of audit/assurance actions.
Support training effectiveness and engagement
Support onboarding and training effectiveness for new joiners and/or new process rollouts, including tracking and reporting.
Contribute to a positive site culture by participating in local committees/initiatives (e.g., GPTW, Wellness, Risk, Customer Service, People) and driving agreed actions.
Requirements
10+ years’ experience in banking operations / shared services / operational excellence / operations control environments.
Proven track record delivering operational improvements that resulted in sustained BAU performance uplift (not limited to planning or coordination).
Strong ability to convert operational problems into practical requirements and workable procedures, including exception handling and control requirements.
Strong analytical skills and MI fluency; able to interpret trends, diagnose root causes, and drive targeted interventions.
Confident stakeholder management across Operations, Technology, and control partners; comfortable influencing decisions and escalating issues early.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to operate under pressure and shifting priorities.
Graduate in any discipline.
What will set you apart
Hands-on experience supporting automation/digitization in operations (e.g., workflow tools and AI-enabled assist/triage where applicable), with evidence of adoption and benefits realized.
A practical understanding of AI capabilities and boundaries (e.g., what AI is good at vs. where human judgment and controls must remain), gained through using AI-enabled tools in an operational environment. This role does not require deep AI product management expertise or model development experience.
Experience delivering simplification in a regulated environment, including navigating approvals and evidencing that controls remain effective post-change.
Experience building BAU routines that sustain change (readiness playbooks, hyper care, MI cadence, QA calibration, continuous improvement governance).
Multi-site / cross-team delivery experience.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

弹性福利
当您考虑为家庭提供更多保障时，My Choice员工弹性福利平台可以满足您不同人生阶段的各种需求。每年您都享有弹性福利积分，可以调整您的福利保险，买卖年假，为家人购买体检套餐等，DIY一份专属于您的福利计划。

企业年金
汇丰企业年金这一补充养老金计划为您更添一份保障。建立企业账户和个人账户，由汇丰和您按照一定比例每月缴存。更有专业的金融机构共同运营，确保年金资金的安全独立、灵活投资，您可在退休时领取，提升您退休后的生活品质。
弹性工作

jobs.title: Lead Architect
jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Lead Architect
.
Business: CTO Data Technology
Job ID: 54475
Principal Responsibilities
Rapidly understanding business requirements through regular interactions with the CIB Chief Data Office (CDO), business users and other subject matter experts.
Translating business requirements into solution designs and functional requirements.
Building technical and logical designs
Communication of functional solutions to the development team plus ongoing support of the developers as needed.
Working closely with the production support team to ensure all new software is well understood and readily supported.
Active promotion of solution architecture, best practice techniques, standards and tools
Providing recommendations and roadmaps for proposed solutions
Documenting and sharing best practice knowledge for new solutions
Advocating for process improvements and helping develop solutions
Providing technical leadership to a team throughout the project lifecycle
Developing proof-of-concept projects to validate your proposed solutions
Reviewing and validating solutions designs from other team members
Managing and defining the detailed end to end solution design for products and features in a way that supports the execution of the technology strategy and roadmap, articulating and addressing associated architectural risks, issues and technical debt.
Ensuring the design of the solutions are cost effective and maintained through the agile development lifecycle, managing the flow of the backlog of design activities.
Ensuring the architecture undergoes appropriate level of assessment at the right stage throughout the agile process in line with the governance process
Ensuring appropriate level of governance for any decisions when deviating from reference architectures, strategies, patterns or policies.
Ensuring peer review and solutions design decision making verification and traceability
Collaborating with the Enterprise, Platform and Value Stream architects to evolve the architectural strategy and roadmap; looking for opportunities to improve the current landscape/enterprise.
Note that some project management may be required from time to time to ensure the success of any project implementing requirements the candidate has specified.
Requirements
At least 5 years’ experience of working within a large, complex and geographically dispersed organisation (including matrix management structure and across time zones) as a Solution Architect
Ability to think logically and abstract the architectural patterns from the technical solutions
Strong leadership and an ability to articulate, present and obtain approval for solutions at the right level for a wide audience (IT and Business)
Experience with Streaming technologies (Kafka, Flink, Pub/Sub)
Knowledge of application integration patterns: REST API, Microservices
Knowledge of database technologies: SQL / NoSQL
Knowledge of Data Warehousing & ETL / data integration aspects
Operating Systems & Scripting: Linux, Shell Scripting (Bash, AWK), PowerShell
Experience with any cloud platform: GCP, Azure, AWS
Experience with Big Data platforms: BQ, Hadoop, Spark, Databricks
Knowledge of containerization concepts: Docker, Kubernetes (IKP, GKE)

jobs.title: Vice President, Ops Support
jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Vice President, Ops Support.
Principal responsibilities
Set direction and govern the Ops Support agenda (AI-first + simplification + performance)
Own and drive the RBWS Ops Support priorities aligned to Hong Kong Operations strategy: AI-first operating model adoption, process/policy simplification, and sustained operational performance uplift.
Build and maintain a prioritized portfolio of initiatives with clear outcomes, sequencing, dependencies, and measurable benefits (e.g., SLA/TAT, productivity, quality, rework reduction, colleague experience).
Establish robust governance: cadence, decision forums, RAID discipline, and clear accountability from design through stabilization.
Lead execution into BAU at scale
Ensure changes are converted into stable BAU execution through clear procedures, training reinforcement, effective MI routines, and operational ownership.
Sponsor operational readiness and rollout discipline: go/no-go criteria, fallback arrangements, hyper care, and post-implementation performance tracking.
Drive standardization and reduce variation where it improves right-first-time outcomes and strengthens control integrity.
Strengthen risk management and continuously improve control effectiveness (end-to-end)
Proactively identify operational risks, control gaps, and emerging issues using MI, quality/error themes, incidents, audit/assurance feedback, colleague feedback, and journey breakpoints.
Lead timely remediation: ensure actions are owned, prioritized, tracked to closure with evidence, and translated into sustained BAU practices (not one-off fixes).
Review existing control design and drive enhancements to improve control effectiveness and efficiency, especially where processes are being digitized, simplified or re-shaped by AI-first operating model changes.
Ensure controls remain effective through change by embedding requirements into delivery: control points, evidence expectations, exception handling, auditability, and clear accountability across handoffs.
Partner with relevant risk and control stakeholders (Operations Risk, Compliance, second line where applicable) to assess change impacts, agree treatment plans, and ensure alignment to risk appetite and policy intent.
Strengthen preventative controls and “right-first-time” execution by addressing root causes through process design, clearer decisioning, better guidance, capability uplift, and improved tooling support.
Partner with Technology and change teams to embed automation/digitization safely
Provide senior operational leadership to shape and implement automation/digitization (e.g., workflow automation and AI-enabled assistance where applicable), ensuring solutions reflect real operational scenarios, exceptions, constraints, and control requirements.
Ensure operational testing and validation is rigorous (including edge cases) and that adoption mechanisms are in place so solutions are used effectively and safely in frontline operations.
Act as an escalation point to resolve trade-offs between speed, customer outcomes, risk/control requirements, and operational practicality.
Deliver simplification of process and policy (with clear risk alignment)
Lead identification and prioritization of simplification opportunities that reduce complexity, handoffs and rework while remaining aligned to policy intent and risk appetite.
Partner with policy/process owners and control stakeholders to land simplifications with documented rationale, approvals, and post-change assurance of control effectiveness.
Track and communicate simplification impact using clear measures (step reduction, cycle-time improvement, error reduction, fewer escalations/complaints where applicable).
Own MI, performance management, and benefits realization
Set expectations for MI quality and performance routines; ensure decision-making is grounded in facts (capacity, backlog drivers, SLA/TAT, quality/error trends, learning curve impacts).
Hold teams accountable for benefits realization and sustainability, driving corrective actions where outcomes drift post-implementation.
Provide clear, decision-oriented updates to senior stakeholders on progress, risks/issues, and outcomes.
Lead, develop, and motivate the Ops Support team
Directly manage Senior Managers/Ops Support leads; set clear objectives and coaching plans tied to operational outcomes, risk discipline and leadership behaviors.
Build capability across problem-solving, data/MI fluency, change landing, and control mindset.
Foster an inclusive, high-performance culture across the site, role-modelling HSBC values and collaboration.
Represent Ops Support in site and people governance
Actively lead and participate in site committees/initiatives (e.g., GPTW, Wellness, Risk, Customer Service, People), ensuring activities deliver tangible impact on engagement, capability and risk culture.
Requirements
15+ years’ experience in banking operations / shared services / operational excellence / operations control leadership roles, with senior accountability for outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to lead multi-threaded operational improvement portfolios and drive measurable performance uplift that sustains in BAU.
Strong risk and control leadership in a 1LoD operations environment: proven ability to identify issues early, drive root-cause remediation, and improve control effectiveness over time.
Proven senior stakeholder management across Operations, Technology, policy/process owners, and risk/control stakeholders; confident influencing decisions and resolving conflicts.
Strong data/MI fluency: able to challenge performance narratives, diagnose root causes, and drive evidence-led prioritization.
People leadership experience: hiring/coaching, objective-setting, performance management, and talent development.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to operate effectively under pressure and ambiguity.
What will set you apart
Track record of embedding automation/digitization into operations with adoption and benefits realized (e.g., workflow-enabled execution, AI-assisted colleague workflows where applicable).
Practical understanding of AI capabilities and boundaries (what AI is good at vs. where human judgement and controls must remain), gained through using or implementing AI-enabled tools in an operational environment—without needing deep AI product management or model development expertise.
Experience simplifying processes/policies in a regulated environment while strengthening control effectiveness and auditability.
Experience building BAU routines that sustain change (MI cadence, QA calibration, hyper care models, continuous improvement governance).
Multi-site / cross-market delivery exposure and the ability to standardize intelligently without ignoring local constraints.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
扩大卓越理财客户群，并与卓越理财客户建立长期关系
根据客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富
向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门
配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证
Qualifications
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
Fluency in Mandarin and English
本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳
具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系
具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流
以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务
了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣
成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现
具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧
普通话及英语流利
我们的福利
汇丰为员工提供全面、贴心的关怀与福利，自入职第一天起，员工就可以在多样化和人性化的工作场所做出积极选择，满足自己多层次的需求。
假期福利
除法定休假外，有年假、带薪病假、志愿者假、妇女节、休假等。您入职后即可享有10~25天的丰厚年假，让您在工作之余有充分的时间放松身心。在您生日当月，更有一天生日假，您可以和家人、朋友等一起庆祝这温馨的时刻。
全面的福利保险计划
包括定期寿险、意外伤亡险、重疾险、补充商业医疗保险等，覆盖全方位生活场景，为您的保障添砖加瓦。
员工体检
每年为您提供一次关爱体检，有多种套餐，全面评估您的身体状况和生活方式，帮助您实现健康生活、快乐工作。
弹性福利
当您考虑为家庭提供更多保障时，MyChoice员工弹性福利平台可以满足您不同人生阶段的各种需求。每年您都享有弹性福利积分，可以调整您的福利保险，买卖年假，为家人购买体检套餐等，DIY一份专属于您的福利计划。
心理健康咨询
您和您的直系亲属均可免费获得专业的心理健康咨询，包含个人成长、缓解职场压力、解决情感困惑等，助您一路“升级打怪”，稳步前进。
企业年金
汇丰企业年金这一补充养老金计划为您更添一份保障。建立企业账户和个人账户，由汇丰和您按照一定比例每月缴存。更有专业的金融机构共同运营，确保年金资金的安全独立、灵活投资，您可在退休时领取，提升您退休后的生活品质。
弹性工作
为了让大家发挥最佳表现，您有各种弹性工作的灵活选择。
PSQP专业进修计划

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

扩大卓越理财客户群，并与卓越理财客户建立长期关系

根据客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富

向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门

配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

Qualifications

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳

具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系

具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流

以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务

了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣

成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现

具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧

普通话及英语流利

汇丰为员工提供全面、贴心的关怀与福利，自入职第一天起，员工就可以在多样化和人性化的工作场所做出积极选择，满足自己多层次的需求。

除法定休假外，有年假、带薪病假、志愿者假、妇女节、休假等。您入职后即可享有10~25天的丰厚年假，让您在工作之余有充分的时间放松身心。在您生日当月，更有一天生日假，您可以和家人、朋友等一起庆祝这温馨的时刻。

  • 全面的福利保险计划

每年为您提供一次关爱体检，有多种套餐，全面评估您的身体状况和生活方式，帮助您实现健康生活、快乐工作。

当您考虑为家庭提供更多保障时，MyChoice员工弹性福利平台可以满足您不同人生阶段的各种需求。每年您都享有弹性福利积分，可以调整您的福利保险，买卖年假，为家人购买体检套餐等，DIY一份专属于您的福利计划。

您和您的直系亲属均可免费获得专业的心理健康咨询，包含个人成长、缓解职场压力、解决情感困惑等，助您一路“升级打怪”，稳步前进。

  • 企业年金

汇丰企业年金这一补充养老金计划为您更添一份保障。建立企业账户和个人账户，由汇丰和您按照一定比例每月缴存。更有专业的金融机构共同运营，确保年金资金的安全独立、灵活投资，您可在退休时领取，提升您退休后的生活品质。

  • 弹性工作

为了让大家发挥最佳表现，您有各种弹性工作的灵活选择。

jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Lead Architect
.
Business: CTO Data Technology
Job ID: 54475
Principal Responsibilities
Rapidly understanding business requirements through regular interactions with the CIB Chief Data Office (CDO), business users and other subject matter experts.
Translating business requirements into solution designs and functional requirements.
Building technical and logical designs
Communication of functional solutions to the development team plus ongoing support of the developers as needed.
Working closely with the production support team to ensure all new software is well understood and readily supported.
Active promotion of solution architecture, best practice techniques, standards and tools
Providing recommendations and roadmaps for proposed solutions
Documenting and sharing best practice knowledge for new solutions
Advocating for process improvements and helping develop solutions
Providing technical leadership to a team throughout the project lifecycle
Developing proof-of-concept projects to validate your proposed solutions
Reviewing and validating solutions designs from other team members
Managing and defining the detailed end to end solution design for products and features in a way that supports the execution of the technology strategy and roadmap, articulating and addressing associated architectural risks, issues and technical debt.
Ensuring the design of the solutions are cost effective and maintained through the agile development lifecycle, managing the flow of the backlog of design activities.
Ensuring the architecture undergoes appropriate level of assessment at the right stage throughout the agile process in line with the governance process
Ensuring appropriate level of governance for any decisions when deviating from reference architectures, strategies, patterns or policies.
Ensuring peer review and solutions design decision making verification and traceability
Collaborating with the Enterprise, Platform and Value Stream architects to evolve the architectural strategy and roadmap; looking for opportunities to improve the current landscape/enterprise.
Note that some project management may be required from time to time to ensure the success of any project implementing requirements the candidate has specified.
Requirements
At least 5 years’ experience of working within a large, complex and geographically dispersed organisation (including matrix management structure and across time zones) as a Solution Architect
Ability to think logically and abstract the architectural patterns from the technical solutions
Strong leadership and an ability to articulate, present and obtain approval for solutions at the right level for a wide audience (IT and Business)
Experience with Streaming technologies (Kafka, Flink, Pub/Sub)
Knowledge of application integration patterns: REST API, Microservices
Knowledge of database technologies: SQL / NoSQL
Knowledge of Data Warehousing & ETL / data integration aspects
Operating Systems & Scripting: Linux, Shell Scripting (Bash, AWK), PowerShell
Experience with any cloud platform: GCP, Azure, AWS
Experience with Big Data platforms: BQ, Hadoop, Spark, Databricks
Knowledge of containerization concepts: Docker, Kubernetes (IKP, GKE)
Experience in designing with good understanding on abstraction techniques
Proven analysis skills with the ability to challenge designs / decisions.
Experience in managing and resolving complex issues using proven analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to quickly get up to speed with the current data landscape and apply acquired analysis and data skills to new contexts and approaches
Excellent spoken and written communication skills. A strong ability to communicate virtually e.g. conference calls and video conferencing
Strong planning, organisation and time management skills with a demonstrated ability to work to deadlines
Commercial acumen and ability to apply this to Business and IT data requirements
Self-awareness and with the confidence to work independently

jobs.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.

扩大卓越尊尚客户群，并与卓越尊尚客户建立长期关系

根据卓越尊尚客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富

向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门

配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

卓越尊尚客户总监需要具备与现有客户和潜在客户建立互信的关系，帮助客户表达真实需求，以及帮助客户达成期望的能力

Qualifications

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline

At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳

至少5年以上客户经理经验

具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系

具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流

以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务

了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣

成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现

具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧

普通话及英语流利

我们的福利

汇丰为员工提供全面、贴心的关怀与福利，自入职第一天起，员工就可以在多样化和人性化的工作场所做出积极选择，满足自己多层次的需求。

  • 假期福利

除法定休假外，有年假、带薪病假、志愿者假、妇女节、休假等。您入职后即可享有10~25天的丰厚年假，让您在工作之余有充分的时间放松身心。在您生日当月，更有一天生日假，您可以和家人、朋友等一起庆祝这温馨的时刻。

  • 全面的福利保险计划

包括定期寿险、意外伤亡险、重疾险、补充商业医疗保险等，覆盖全方位生活场景，为您的保障添砖加瓦。

  • 员工体检

每年为您提供一次关爱体检，有多种套餐，全面评估您的身体状况和生活方式，帮助您实现健康生活、快乐工作。

  • 弹性福利

当您考虑为家庭提供更多保障时，My Choice员工弹性福利平台可以满足您不同人生阶段的各种需求。每年您都享有弹性福利积分，可以调整您的福利保险，买卖年假，为家人购买体检套餐等，DIY一份专属于您的福利计划。

  • 心理健康咨询

您和您的直系亲属均可免费获得专业的心理健康咨询，包含个人成长、缓解职场压力、解决情感困惑等，助您一路“升级打怪”，稳步前进。

  • 企业年金

汇丰企业年金这一补充养老金计划为您更添一份保障。建立企业账户和个人账户，由汇丰和您按照一定比例每月缴存。更有专业的金融机构共同运营，确保年金资金的安全独立、灵活投资，您可在退休时领取，提升您退休后的生活品质。

  • 弹性工作

为了让大家发挥最佳表现，您有各种弹性工作的灵活选择。

  • PSQP专业进修计划

专业进修计划通过为员工报销学费的方式鼓励员工追求职业发展。员工可就经PSQP批核的进修计划和经批核学位列表中涵盖的专业进修享受学费报销

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Enablement and Commercialisation
jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Senior Manager, Data Enablement and Commercialisation
.
Business: A sia & Middle East COO
Job ID: 48765
Principal Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
Drive cost efficiency by identifying synergies across markets for data spending.
Understand global AI use cases and produce market level roadmaps of adoption, support Asia International Market COO's identifying key initiatives to advocate for acceleration.
Partner with Market / GBGI CDAO and LOB to identify commercialization use cases to drive value out of R&C & Simplification portfolio e.g. commercialisation of payments data.
Oversee Data Change related initiatives.
Provide support AME International Market COO with data for Innovation related initiatives.
Data Enablement and Commercialisation
Build and manage a pipeline of scalable, data-backed use cases across Asia International Markets, from ideation through delivery and adoption.
Identify and commercialise use cases that unlock value from strategic portfolios (e.g., Risk & Controls, Simplification).
Drive regulatory reporting automation and enable re-use of data assets for analytics, MI, and business performance improvement.
Partner with Market / GBGI CDAO and LoB to map improvement opportunities in regulatory reporting, MI, and information fulfilment; champion reporting simplification across markets.
Support business development and operational efficiency by enabling self-service insights and fit-for-purpose data products.
Cross-market Strategy, Roadmaps, and Cost Efficiency
Understand global AI and data use cases and translate them into market-level adoption roadmaps, prioritised by value, feasibility, and risk.
Identify synergies across markets to improve cost efficiency and reduce duplication in data spend, tooling, and delivery approaches.
Support International Market COOs in identifying and advocating for initiatives requiring acceleration or investment.
Delivery Oversight: Data Change and Execution Governance
Oversee data change initiatives across Asia International Markets, ensuring delivery discipline, benefits tracking, and stakeholder alignment.
Drive delivery and execution of data risk reduction across Asia International Markets, leveraging on the AME Data Risk Reduction Book of Work and other such investments across Asia International Markets.
Alignment of relevant OKRs and metrics from HSBC Data Strategy, prioritization of funding, and progress reporting, addressing data related regulatory expectation, and contribute to the reduction of data risk rating for Asia International Markets.
Establish an effective mechanism to triage new data risk demand to respective delivery pods for prioritisation and execution, with DAO and AME CDAO portfolio and project management team.
Contribute to measurable reduction in data risk ratings and improved control automation outcomes.
Data Literacy and Enablement At Scale
Champion data literacy, self-service, and adoption of best practices across Asia International Markets.
Support CDAO for Asia International Markets in sharing data best practices across markets and building a consistent enablement approach.
Develop foundational training content and materials to uplift data capability across the teams.
Deliver the data enablement activity plan for Asia International Markets (communications, training, adoption metrics).
Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications
Essential Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Data / Business Analytics, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
8+ years’ progressive experience in data, datasets, and data tooling; including at least 3 years in a leadership role overseeing large-scale data/analytics delivery.
Solid knowledge of data enablement practices, data commercialisation, data platforms, and data management trends.
Demonstrated ability to identify and execute improvement opportunities in the data domain; exposure to tools / languages such as Python, Alteryx, Qlik Sense (or equivalent).
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across senior executives and diverse delivery teams.
Strong understanding on HSBC’s Value Stream construct and its evolving changes, with relevant expertise to manage investment discussions, delivery roadmap and metrics.
Strong understanding in HSBC’s organizational and awareness on recent changes across the enterprise, with solid experience to navigate complexities across global, regional, and market expectations.
Strong literacy and understanding on the refreshed HSBC Data Strategy and its Execution Roadmap, across key technology components (Reference Data, Data Fabric, Control Automation), and business outcomes (e.g. Non-Resident Chinese growth for Hong Kong business).
Essential Capabilities
Cultivates Innovation: Creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful. Willing to challenge and change traditional approaches.
Strategic Mindset: Seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies.
Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.
Build Effective Teams: With the capabilities to navigate the matrix, deliver across multiple teams, and influence stakeholders to achieve shared outcomes.
Drives Vision & Purpose: Painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others to action.
Being Resilient: Rebounding from setbacks and adversity when facing difficult situations.
Manages ambiguity and ensures accountability: Operating effectively, even when things are not certain, or the way forward is not clear; holds self and others accountable to meet commitments.
Persuasion & Conviction: Using compelling arguments to gain the support and commitment of others including senior executives; stepping up to address difficult issues and saying what needs to be said.
Risk Management: Balancing the execution at pace, with protecting the Customer and the Bank in decision making. Experience in making rounded decisions that take all stakeholders into account.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role./WX
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

jobs.title: Manager - Data and Analytics
jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Manager - Data and Analytics.
Principal responsibilities
Explore, cleanse and transform large volumes of customer, product, channel and interaction data across platforms including GCP and Hadoop.
Develop cross-sell/NBA analytics, including propensity/uplift models, segmentation, eligibility rules and prioritisation logic.
Engineer features from CRM and behavioural signals (e.g., digital journeys, RM activities, campaign responses) to improve model performance and interpretability.
Build and iterate prototypes using Python/SQL and relevant tooling; create decision-ready dashboards and monitoring views in Looker.
Partner with CRM, product and Business stakeholders to define use cases, success metrics and test-and-learn approaches (e.g., A/B testing, champion–challenger).
Communicate modelling approach, assumptions, limitations and outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Translate insights into actionable recommendations and implementation-ready artefacts (e.g., scoring outputs, business rules, playbooks, targeting lists).
Drive continuous improvement through automation and modern tooling (including AI/LLM-enabled approaches where appropriate) to streamline analysis and delivery.
Maintain strong engineering discipline (version control, documentation, reproducibility) and contribute to shared code assets.
Requirements
3+ years’ experience in banking analytics/data science, with a structured and well-organised approach to delivery.
Strong understanding of CMB products and operating model, with particular depth in CRM and customer engagement processes.
Advanced Python and SQL skills, with proven experience analysing large datasets and performing complex statistical analysis.
Demonstrated end-to-end delivery experience (development through implementation) in at least one of the following: recommendation/next-best-action, customer propensity modelling, uplift modelling, NLP/NLU, social network analysis, or path analysis (e.g., browsing behaviour or geolocation).
Strong working knowledge of GCP services and analytics tooling; solid understanding of Hadoop concepts and ecosystem.
Proven track record of converting data into insights and delivering measurable business impact (e.g., conversion uplift, increased product penetration, improved RM productivity).
Strong stakeholder management, presentation and communication skills.
Active GitHub contributor (or equivalent evidence of strong version control and collaborative coding practices).
Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English.
Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.
Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

  • Communicate modelling approach, assumptions, limitations and outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Translate insights into actionable recommendations and implementation-ready artefacts (e.g., scoring outputs, business rules, playbooks, targeting lists).
  • Drive continuous improvement through automation and modern tooling (including AI/LLM-enabled approaches where appropriate) to streamline analysis and delivery.
  • Maintain strong engineering discipline (version control, documentation, reproducibility) and contribute to shared code assets.

Requirements

  • 3+ years’ experience in banking analytics/data science, with a structured and well-organised approach to delivery.
  • Strong understanding of CMB products and operating model, with particular depth in CRM and customer engagement processes.
  • Advanced Python and SQL skills, with proven experience analysing large datasets and performing complex statistical analysis.
  • Demonstrated end-to-end delivery experience (development through implementation) in at least one of the following: recommendation/next-best-action, customer propensity modelling, uplift modelling, NLP/NLU, social network analysis, or path analysis (e.g., browsing behaviour or geolocation).
  • Strong working knowledge of GCP services and analytics tooling; solid understanding of Hadoop concepts and ecosystem.
  • Proven track record of converting data into insights and delivering measurable business impact (e.g., conversion uplift, increased product penetration, improved RM productivity).
  • Strong stakeholder management, presentation and communication skills.
  • Active GitHub contributor (or equivalent evidence of strong version control and collaborative coding practices).
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in English.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

CIB - Global Payments Solutions (GPS)
Global Payment Solutions (GPS) is made up of almost 10,000 colleagues across 58 countries and territories. This business is uniquely positioned to help clients make payments across borders, currencies and regulations, quickly and efficiently with dedicated in-country and regional support. Our expertise in this area is repeatedly recognised by the industry’s most prominent publications and associations with numerous global, regional, and country awards.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
To assist develop new corporate customer opportunities within your assigned region. Manage outbound initiatives to penetrate new markets and expand our footprint. Actively promote GPS products (A/R, A/P, Liquidity, Channel Management) to address specific client pain points, positioning HSBC as the partner of choice for cross-border transactional needs.
To track pipeline progress rigorously and analyze sales data to help with comprehensive account planning. Provide accurate forecasts and insights into leadership, ensuring alignment with regional sales targets and strategic goals.
To organize and execute high-impact events and marketing activities to elevate the GPS brand within the cash management business. Build and maintain long-term, trusted relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and retention.
To engage in sales playbooks, case studies, and industry insights with the wider GPS sales network to elevate team performance. Coordinate internal resources to meet tight deadlines and specific expectations.
To cross-team collaborate with GPS Product and Client Management teams to deliver tailored solutions. Act as the bridge between client needs and internal capabilities to ensure seamless service delivery.
To support other business-related tasks and admin stuff as required.

Minimum 5 years related working experience, of which at least 3 years are related to transactional banking business or corporate relationship management, LC/MME client experience is a plus

jobs.title: Assistant Manager, Business Support
jobs.descriptionText:
The role of Assistant Manager, Business Support directly reports to Head of Business Development. The primary reponsibilities of the role are to provide business support to Wholesale Distribution teams of the branches and to drive the implementation of the business development plans and strategies.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Act as the key contact point with Banc and Broker Channel to develop and maintain a sound and sustainable partnership, with directly reporting to the distribution support head. It ensures effective mutual communication and facilitates strategy implementation to boost sales across the entity.
Analyze and regularly track on the business performance and KPIs of the branches and channels, not limited to product mix, frontline productivity, sales targets and results analysis.
Track and analyze the effectiveness of business promotion plans and other initiatives, including tracking the strategic project such as IS execution
Conduct the activity analysis on the business support of BDMs through daily logs to support the transition of BDMs
Maintain BDM Scorecard dashboard and periodically communicate with frontlines and related departments, including monthly/quarterly BDM Scorecard report generation, BDM Scorecard result communication, system upgrade and function optimization.
Board paper preparation and assist CDO to develop and execute the business development plans and strategies
Plan and organize distribution related forum, committee or meeting to review business progress and sales qualities issues
Coordinate and calibrate the business support at branches in accordance with the feedback received from partners and support distribution related matters at branch level, especially to coordinate on local regulator special asks.
Update channel management policies to ensure the smooth running of business as well as its legality and compliance and conduct regular self-assessment to ensure the effectiveness of the policies.
Assist line manager to develop and execute the business development plans and strategies
Perform other reasonable duties as assigned, and undertake responsibilities as needed to address changing business requirements and management direction.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Strong educational background with bachelor’s degree; overseas education experience or finance related degrees are preferred
At least two years of work experience in financial service industry
Team player and strong communication and interpersonal skills
Strong analytical skills
Proficiency in English

.

Principal responsibilities
Rapidly understanding business requirements through regular interactions with the CIB Chief Data Office (CDO), business users and other subject matter experts.
Translating business requirements into solution designs and functional requirements.
Building technical and logical designs
Communication of functional solutions to the development team plus ongoing support of the developers as needed.

Advocating for process improvements and helping develop solutions

Reviewing and validating solutions designs from other team members
Managing and defining the detailed end to end solution design for products and features in a way that supports the execution of the technology strategy and roadmap, articulating and addressing associated architectural risks, issues and technical debt.
Ensuring the design of the solutions are cost effective and maintained through the agile development lifecycle, managing the flow of the backlog of design activities.
Ensuring the architecture undergoes appropriate level of assessment at the right stage throughout the agile process in line with the governance process
Ensuring appropriate level of governance for any decisions when deviating from reference architectures, strategies, patterns or policies.
Ensuring peer review and solutions design decision making verification and traceability
Collaborating with the Enterprise, Platform and Value Stream architects to evolve the architectural strategy and roadmap; looking for opportunities to improve the current landscape/enterprise.
Note that some project management may be required from time to time to ensure the success of any project implementing requirements the candidate has specified.
Requirements
At least 5 years’ experience of working within a large, complex and geographically dispersed organisation (including matrix management structure and across time zones) as a Solution Architect
Ability to think logically and abstract the architectural patterns from the technical solutions
Strong leadership and an ability to articulate, present and obtain approval for solutions at the right level for a wide audience (IT and Business)
Experience with Streaming technologies (Kafka, Flink, Pub/Sub)
Knowledge of application integration patterns: REST API, Microservices
Knowledge of database technologies: SQL / NoSQL
Knowledge of Data Warehousing & ETL / data integration aspects
Operating Systems & Scripting: Linux, Shell Scripting (Bash, AWK), PowerShell
Experience with any cloud platform: GCP, Azure, AWS
Experience with Big Data platforms: BQ, Hadoop, Spark, Databricks
Knowledge of containerization concepts: Docker, Kubernetes (IKP, GKE)
Experience in designing with good understanding on abstraction techniques
Proven analysis skills with the ability to challenge designs / decisions.
Experience in managing and resolving complex issues using proven analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to quickly get up to speed with the current data landscape and apply acquired analysis and data skills to new contexts and approaches
Excellent spoken and written communication skills. A strong ability to communicate virtually e.g. conference calls and video conferencing
Strong planning, organisation and time management skills with a demonstrated ability to work to deadlines
Commercial acumen and ability to apply this to Business and IT data requirements
Self-awareness and with the confidence to work independently
